title: galarhoeus ebracteolatus var. coreanus
intro: Galarhoeus ebracteolatus var. coreanus, commonly known as Korean gallium, is a plant species in the family Anacardiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Korean gallium include anti-allergic, anti-arthritic, and anti-cancer properties, as well as cardiovascular and neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Korean gallium include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
